headword: {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}

definitions.gloss: status of residence; residence qualification; visa status
definitions.explanation: The legal status granted to foreign nationals allowing them to reside in Japan for a specific purpose, such as work, study, or family ties. Defined under Japan's Immigration Control Act.

examples.japanese: {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied for a change of residence status.

examples.japanese: {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}けない→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: You cannot work in Japan without a residence status.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{就労|しゅうろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{入管|にゅうかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To switch from a student to a work residence status, you need to complete procedures at the immigration bureau.

notes:
USAGE:
Essential vocabulary for foreigners living in Japan. There are 29 categories of residence status, including ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧・{人文知識|じんぶんちしき}・{国際業務|こくさいぎょうむ} (engineer/specialist in humanities/international services), ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧ (student), and {永住者|えいじゅうしゃ} (permanent resident).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧ (to obtain a residence status)
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧ (to renew a residence status)
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (change of residence status)
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}{認定|にんてい}{証明書|しょうめいしょ} (Certificate of Eligibility)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧: visa — the entry permit stamped in a passport; technically separate from residence status
- ⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}カード→在留カード：23526_zairyuukaado⟧: residence card — the physical ID card issued to foreign residents
